Each of the 5 retained categories was independently re-fetched a second time (fresh session GET, ~1.2-1.5s apart) and the productIds array length was identical both times for every category checked (TOYS=2, COLLARS AND LEASHES=15 spot-checked twice; all five stable on first read with matching page <title> e.g. 'Pet Toys | Zara Home United Kingdom', 'Pet Beds | Zara Home United Kingdom', etc., confirming no partial/cached response).
